name: zfmv_script_run_blocking
description: zFMV_Script::RunBlocking sets the abort-on-key mode, begins playback, updates until the script is drained, rewinds without destroying actions, and returns success.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this FMV script loop; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x462f50 validates storing m_abortOnKey, calling BeginAtTime once, calling UpdateAtTime once before the polling loop, continuing while UpdateAtTime returns nonzero, rewinding with BeginNow(0), preserving ESI, and returning 1.
The dependency frontier for 0x462f50 has no visible source blockers; BeginAtTime, UpdateAtTime, and BeginNow are accepted functional dependencies.

The native smoke verifies the empty-script return/rewind case with a nonzero abort-on-key value and an action-backed run that begins the current action, consumes one completed update/end, rewinds m_cur to m_head without destroying the action, preserves the zero abort-on-key mode used to avoid input polling in the isolated fixture, and initializes the FMV sample set through BeginAtTime.
